## 7. API contract (QG-8)

**This is the first time QG-8 can actually be satisfied** — the gate has always required an API-contract suite for mobile and MCP consumers, and none existed.

| Endpoint | Consumer | Role | Result | Field diff |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST login` | mobile + MCP | Sales Agent | PASS | none — envelope and all 9 asserted fields as expected |
| `POST login` | mobile + MCP | Business Sales Agent | PASS | none; `free_trial_status` forced `true` as the controller branch dictates |
| `POST login` | mobile + MCP | Business Agent | PASS | refused with the role message, no token |
| `POST login` | mobile + MCP | Public / invalid | PASS | generic message; no account enumeration |
| `POST login` | mobile + MCP | Admin | **BLOCKED** | not measurable — no credentials |

**Baseline now pinned for every future V2 suite:** HTTP 200 on handled failures, `status` is the **string** `"1"`/`"0"`, plus `message`, `data`, `is_subscription_expired`; success adds `unread_notification_count`.
